Shared helpers retain machine-specific paths and external client/Unity/editor dependency requirements; migration does not prove standalone execution after clone. Installer currently does not validate manifest requiresInstalled; run nowhere in this review.

Old design metadata can refer to removed source images. Only extant current final art and provenance records are included; no absent historical images restored.
